description: The closed set of actor classes recorded against every IDauto submission and audit-log row. Adopted verbatim platform-wide by Mythos OS. Describes a deployed CHECK constraint, not a convergence target.

compatibility.value_order: declaration order of the SQL CHECK; non-normative — comparisons are set equality
compatibility.additive: new value -> same major file, revision + 1
compatibility.deprecation: value stays present with status 'deprecated' for >= 1 major version
compatibility.breaking: removal, rename, or semantic change -> new file actor-type.v2.json; v1 retained with status 'superseded'

values.description: An IDauto service acting on its own behalf. actor_ref is svc_<name>.
An authenticated public submitter. actor_ref is usr_<uuidv7>.
A member of a subscriber organisation. actor_ref is usr_<uuidv7>.
An operator-provisioned administrative identity. actor_ref is usr_<uuidv7>.
Unauthenticated caller. actor_ref is NULL; an identifier is never invented.
